summary: BEP filed a 6-K press release on its proposed corporate structure simplification, which would combine BEP and BEPC into a single publicly traded corporation, Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. The special unitholder meeting was adjourned from an earlier date to October 29, 2026, with a record date of August 21, 2026 and proxy deadline of October 27, 2026. Votes cast so far show over 99.7% support, but approval requires at least two-thirds of outstanding BEP units as of the record date. Boards of both entities unanimously recommend the Simplification, supported by fairness opinions from Scotiabank; Glass Lewis and ISS also recommend in favor. The BEPC shareholder meeting remains set for October 14, 2026. Watch achieved quorum and turnout thresholds, since the adjournment signals difficulty reaching the two-thirds approval requirement despite overwhelming support among votes cast.
